status: Scoped durable local phrase/raw-key import accepted locally. JSON restore, external/mobile/session/selection persistence and final release gates remain open.
behavior: Local Substrate and EVM imports share the TON/password-change queue. A detached pair is encrypted with the live password, decrypted and checked before a conditional durable write; the keyring pair/observable is published only after acknowledgement.

A durable readable duplicate is authoritative and retains its exact record, metadata, unknown fields and ciphertext. A record arriving after the initial read or a changed encrypted record/deletion is not overwritten.

An unreadable existing record rejects with PREVIOUS_PASSWORD_REQUIRED. It retains all original recovery material for the existing recovery flow. A matching raw key is never allowed to replace an encrypted mnemonic needed by linked networks.

A legacy record whose old password equals the current password receives only durable migration metadata changes. Its original ciphertext, entropy and unknown fields remain intact; isMasterAccount comes from the decrypted stored pair, not the imported copy.

Existing external/mobile identities are not replaced. Current external flags are rechecked before a queued migration update. Ethereum JSON with a 20-byte address header is checked by storage identity and then by its decrypted public key.

Failures reject before selection, and handled write errors do not poison a later password-write flush. A write already submitted may finish during lock; its encrypted record is retained, but late completion/selection rejects until explicit unlock and retry.

findings.description: When an existing account cannot decode with the current password, matching raw-seed import replaces its ciphertext with a pair lacking mnemonic entropy. The old encrypted phrase can be lost while metadata for other mnemonic-derived networks survives. The same primary public key does not prove equivalent retained recovery material.

Exact original mnemonic remains exportable. Independent follow-up source/test review finds the reported loss corrected.
